definitions: A domesticated carnivorous mammal that typically has a long snout, an acute sense of smell, and a barking, howling, or whining voice. It is widely kept as a pet or for work.
The male of some other carnivorous mammals, such as the wolf or fox.
A person regarded as unpleasant, contemptible, or wicked (used as a term of abuse).
A mechanical device for gripping or holding something.
examples: My dog loves to play fetch.
The fox dog was much larger.
The dog held the timber in place.
